scenes.title: Snowy cottage · daylight
scenes.description: One lovely modest timber-and-stone cottage in a quiet snowy conifer forest, a believable pitched roof with thick rounded snow, a stone chimney with a fine plume of smoke drifting naturally, soft winter daytime light, muted honey wood and pale blue snow shadows. House at upper-right at middle distance, snowy foreground, pine and cedar trees genuinely laden with snow. No people, tracks, decorations or oversized fantasy architecture.

scenes.title: Snowy cottage · windowlight
scenes.description: A lovely modest timber-and-stone cottage, thick snow on its pitched roof and surrounding conifers, nighttime deep blue and charcoal forest. Warm amber light FROM WITHIN shines through windows and lights a small patch of untouched snow immediately outside; thin realistic smoke rising from stone chimney. Interior windowlight is the main warm source, faint moonlight outlines snow. Dark scene stays upper-right; pale ivory left and bottom remain light-mode-safe. No people, tracks, decorations, exterior lanterns or fantasy architecture.

scenes.title: Snowfall at the window
scenes.description: Quiet arched fireplace with small flame, a narrow window at extreme right showing soft snowfall on cedar; warm ivory interior meets faint blue winter exterior, muted gentle light.

scenes.title: Snowy forest · low sun
scenes.description: A calm peaceful conifer forest with ground and trees covered in thick untouched snow. No structures and no water. A small LOW WINTER SUN is visibly shining through the distant trees near the horizon at upper-right, casting long soft blue-gray tree shadows FROM the horizon TOWARDS THE CAMERA across foreground snow. Restrained pale butter-gold sunlight, fluffy white snow on cedar and fir boughs, gently layered forest depth. No people or footprints, no impossible rays or inconsistent shadow directions.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · daylight
scenes.description: A small non-frozen stream winds naturally through a peaceful forest covered in thick untouched snow. Flowing water is visibly open dark teal and clear blue-gray, soft gentle ripples; broad thick snowy banks, snow-capped stones and snowy fir/cedar branches. Cool diffuse winter DAYLIGHT with subtle blue-gray shadows. Stream curves through the upper-right scene towards lower-right foreground, visually coherent flowing channel, no tracks or people, no frozen surface or ice over stream, no houses.

scenes.title: Snowy stream · sunset
scenes.description: A small non-frozen stream winds through a peaceful conifer forest with thick untouched snow covering banks, stones and branches. Clearly open flowing dark teal water with restrained copper, gold and blush sunset reflections. Warm SUNSET horizon between trees, coral-peach sky at upper-right, warm light brushing snowy treetops, deep blue-violet shadows on snow. Stream curves naturally towards lower-right foreground, no ice over flowing surface, no people, no tracks, no houses.

scenes.title: Hearth · firelight and moonlight
scenes.description: The approved nighttime variation of Wednesday's scene: same arched plaster hearth, small seed-stem vase, stacked logs and narrow window with snowy evergreen outside. Dark charcoal/indigo interior lit mainly by amber firelight and faint cool moonlight through the window. No daytime sun circle, no electric lights; visible candle unlit. Same composition as Wednesday, pale far-left text area and bottom fade for light-mode UI.

scenes.title: Nā Pali sunrise
scenes.description: Fluted emerald ridges and steep green Nā Pali-like Hawaiian sea cliffs above turquoise Pacific water, faint peach sunrise on cliff edges, fine morning clouds. No fish or monstera.

scenes.title: Monstera morning
scenes.description: A close botanical study of two large sculptural split monstera leaves with correct veins and leaf fenestrations; warm morning light and delicate long plant shadows on ivory plaster, small amber circle of light. No coast or fish.

scenes.title: Sunlit reef
scenes.description: A few anatomically correct yellow tangs and small striped butterflyfish in very clear pale aquamarine shallow reef water, fine sunlight caustics and understated coral rock at extreme right; no smiling fish, no clownfish.

scenes.title: Mist along the cliffs
scenes.description: Lush fluted Nā Pali sea cliffs recede into pale marine mist, muted emerald and blue-teal water, a few distant seabird silhouettes naturally scattered; delicate quiet overcast light.

scenes.title: Rain on monstera
scenes.description: One large elegant monstera leaf and a smaller leaf with correct natural splits, softly detailed tiny rain droplets, cool diffused light on pale cream ground; no landscape or fish.

scenes.title: Reef channel
scenes.description: An elevated diagonal view across rounded coral gardens divided by a deeper teal water channel, with reef triggerfish and smaller whitespotted toby puffers rather than Wednesday's yellow tangs and striped fish. No reflective water ceiling; separate coral mounds and short branched/finger corals. Pale left/bottom fade.

scenes.title: Nā Pali sunset
scenes.description: Fluted green coastal ridges above calm Pacific surf, softly luminous pastel peach and pink sunset behind thin clouds, a few distant seabirds, sea glass water. No tropical collage.

scenes.title: Ice cave · sunrise
scenes.description: A new shallow, broad, low-ceilinged glacier chamber with an asymmetrical long horizontal mouth opening onto a snowy flat horizon. A small visible sun touches the horizon through the opening, casting orange-red dawn light across rippled blue ice walls and the foreground floor. Different cave structure from Tuesday and Thursday.

scenes.title: Sunlit cyan ice
scenes.description: Sunlight passing through a sculptural glacial ice arch makes vivid jewel-like cyan and turquoise scallops, luminous pale snow reflections, delicate trapped bubbles. Bright natural translucency, not neon plastic.

scenes.title: Ice cave · aurora night
scenes.description: A new tall, twisting glacier side-chamber with a narrow irregular vertical opening, fluted ice walls and a rounded foreground ice buttress. Deep teal/indigo night, aurora visible in the exterior sky through the opening, subtly reflected in the ice. Different structure from Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.

scenes.title: Soft blue chamber
scenes.description: A broad undulating blue-ice chamber with pale silvery diffuse winter light, layered rounded frozen water forms, a little lilac-blue shadow and pristine snow floor. No lava or volcanic rock.

scenes.title: Aurora · green and cyan
scenes.description: Natural graceful green and cyan aurora curtains above a quiet Icelandic snow-covered ridge and icy-water reflections. Dark indigo sky only at upper-right; white left and pale bottom remain calm.

scenes.title: Aurora · violet and pink
scenes.description: Different graceful aurora curtain silhouette with soft violet and dusty pink light plus thin pale green lower rays over Icelandic snowy terrain and reflective icy water; natural realistic winter landscape.

scenes.title: Aurora · red and magenta
scenes.description: Unmistakable high-altitude red/ruby/magenta northern-light curtains above thin pale green lower rays over snowy Icelandic ground. Red is light in sky, not lava or fire; restrained luminous fine rays, indigo sky at far right.

scenes.title: Panther forest
scenes.description: Panther Creek inspired horseshoe waterfall with silky long-exposure ribbons and smooth basin flow; warm directional sunlight catches the main right falls while the left forest and smaller veils stay in deeper cool shade.

scenes.title: Fog and sunbeams
scenes.description: Tuesday's original mossy stepped cascade with added forest fog and warm diagonal sunbeams through the canopy, illuminated drifting mist and cool forest shadows. Silky moving water inspired by a natural 1–2 second exposure; stationary rock and foliage detail is preserved.

scenes.title: Rainbow spray
scenes.description: Wednesday's waterfall with a prominent natural rainbow arc in sunlit spray beside the base, translucent colors visible against darker forest and rock. Silky moving water inspired by a natural 1–2 second exposure; stationary rock and foliage detail is preserved.

scenes.title: Ramona lace
scenes.description: A distinct near-frontal forest view inspired by Ramona Falls, Oregon: a broad fan of fine white ribbons over densely fractured columnar basalt, tall evergreen framing, dark moss and cool forest shade. Silky moving water inspired by a natural 1–2 second exposure; stationary rock and foliage detail is preserved.

scenes.title: Rain-fed falls
scenes.description: A slightly fuller forest cascade after spring rain, silver-blue water on dark textured basalt, fern droplets and moist new leaves, overcast pale sky reflected in mist, no violent flood. Silky moving water inspired by a natural 1–2 second exposure; stationary rock and foliage detail is preserved.

scenes.title: Quiet pool
scenes.description: A narrow gentle waterfall feeds a shallow clear forest pool with fine small ripples, mossy stones and a little cedar foliage at far right, restrained late-afternoon spring light. Silky moving water inspired by a natural 1–2 second exposure; stationary rock and foliage detail is preserved.

scenes.title: South Falls · spring
scenes.description: A tall continuous silky plunge inspired by South Falls in Silver Falls State Park, Oregon, over a broad overhanging basalt rim; deep recessed amphitheater and subtle empty walk-behind trail, emerald basin, spring maples, ferns and evergreens.

scenes.title: Rose sunrise
scenes.description: A quiet rose-and-apricot sunrise with a lower translucent peach sun circle, a wider low window angle, long near-horizontal shadows and a delicate seed stem. White translucent curtain catches dawn light, warm light contrasted with pale lavender shade.

scenes.title: Fern shadows
scenes.description: Original Tuesday fern-and-window scene retained, with curtains changed from beige to white sheer gauze, maintaining transparency and folds.

scenes.title: Dappled light
scenes.description: Wednesday dappled-light room, white gauze curtain and flowering sprig, with a true circular translucent golden overlay held in the flat canvas plane.

scenes.title: Pearl daylight
scenes.description: Cool overcast late-morning light through an open side-hinged window, billowing white transparent curtain, subdued sage plant leaves and a very pale pearl circular motif. Soft silvery light without golden sun or hard shadows.

scenes.title: Terracotta sunset
scenes.description: Friday terracotta sunset room and seed stems preserved, with a geometrically circular translucent rust-peach overlay across the wall and window.

scenes.title: Last light
scenes.description: Pale peach translucent sun circle, very fine branching silhouette and low softly horizontal late-day window light; gentle ivory background, clear airy warmth, no dark nighttime room.

scenes.title: Moonlit evening
scenes.description: A quiet moonlit window scene with deep indigo exterior, a translucent silvery moon-circle motif, cool blue moonlight across plaster, fine plant silhouettes and luminous white sheer curtains. Pale left/bottom for light mode.

scenes.title: Coastal sunrise
scenes.description: Oregon Coast dark sea stacks and Pacific surf with pale peach sunrise breaking through marine cloud, distant headland and fine foreground dune grass, a few very small seabirds.

scenes.title: Foggy headland
scenes.description: Layered misty Oregon headlands, a natural offshore sea stack half-shrouded in white marine fog, quiet blue-gray surf and small driftwood at edge; very airy muted atmosphere.

scenes.title: Secret cove · passing showers
scenes.description: A new elevated southern Oregon cove view inspired by Secret Beach, with uneven tree-topped sea-stack clusters and forested bluffs. Sunlit turquoise surf beside dark passing showers, a clear rainbow in falling rain, separate wispy virga fading above the sea.

scenes.title: Tidepool garden
scenes.description: An intimate oblique close-up of clear Oregon rock tidepools, prominent orange and purple ochre sea stars and open green anemones, textured wet basalt, small mussel/barnacle clusters and fine seaweed. No tropical reef.

scenes.title: Secret cove · fiery sunset
scenes.description: A new low beach-level view inspired by southern Oregon's Secret Beach, with dark tree-capped sea stacks and a forested cove, fiery red-orange-magenta sunset clouds reflected across wet sand and shallow beach water.

scenes.title: Coastal sunset
scenes.description: Subtle peach/pink coastal sunset behind a sea stack, Pacific water in pale lavender-blue, soft wave foam and a small loose group of seabirds flying naturally, no dramatic tropical neon.

scenes.title: Coastal afterglow
scenes.description: The existing rocky Oregon coastal cove shortly after sunset, softened blue-hour tones and lingering peach, rose and lavender color in the clouds and subtle wet-beach reflections.

scenes.title: Paradise · Rainier
scenes.description: Mount Rainier from the Paradise area in summer, its broad recognizable glaciated volcanic massif above rolling subalpine meadows thick with violet lupines, magenta paintbrush, white bistort/valerian and small meadow daisies.

scenes.title: Ice Lake · columbines
scenes.description: San Juan Mountains near Ice Lake above Silverton, Colorado, with an intensely blue alpine lake, rugged brown-gray volcanic basin walls and prominent blue-and-white Colorado columbines with long spurs.

scenes.title: North Cascades · sunbreak
scenes.description: A new Sahale Arm/Cascade Pass-inspired ridge view into Washington's North Cascades, layered jagged glacier-cut peaks and a deep forested valley, distinct wildflower ridge foreground, visible sunbeams through broken cloud.

scenes.title: Summer mountain mist
scenes.description: An alpine meadow with a few detailed lavender lupines and muted paintbrush, rocky mountain ridges fading into thin white morning cloud, no snow-dominated winter scene.

scenes.title: Silver Star · dew and beams
scenes.description: A Silver Star-inspired dense native wildflower superbloom in southwest Washington, fog and dew at early morning, low warm sunbeams illuminating wet beargrass, lupines, paintbrush, bistort, daisies and penstemon above a softly layered ridge.

scenes.title: Alpine lake · red sunset
scenes.description: Saturday's existing mountain, lake and wildflower composition retained, relit at evening sunset with low red-orange light on flower edges, mountain faces and lake reflections, cool violet shadows.

scenes.title: Kebler · summer aspens
scenes.description: A magical but natural summer interior of Kebler Pass's giant aspen grove, tall pale trunks with dark knots, fresh green rounded aspen leaves, layered forest depth and a lush floor of large finely divided bracken fern fronds in dappled light.

scenes.title: Island Lake · green teal
scenes.description: Island Lake near Silverton with its small low rocky island, slightly greener glacial teal water, bare San Juan cirque and sparse alpine shoreline.

scenes.title: Emerald Lake · fog
scenes.description: A misty early morning at Yoho's Emerald Lake, deep emerald-blue water, soft spruce reflections and forest/mountain slopes partly obscured by layered fog.

scenes.title: Lake Louise · pale light
scenes.description: Lake Louise-inspired pale milky glacial turquoise lake extending through valley toward distant pale rocky snowy/glacier background, thin conifer shoreline, soft diffuse daylight; water dominates, no buildings or boats.

scenes.title: Island Lake · spotlights
scenes.description: The same Island Lake basin with greener teal water and small rock island under cloud, natural sun shafts spotlighting patches of lake and mountain faces.

scenes.title: Emerald Lake · gold
scenes.description: Glowing jade/blue-teal Yoho lake with warm low sunlight touching conifer shore and distant pale ridge, quiet fine ripples and modest reflected gold, restrained natural late-afternoon.

scenes.title: Lake Louise · red dawn
scenes.description: Saturday's misty lake retained at early sunrise, red light arriving from directly behind the viewer onto the lake, trees and mountains; fog remains.

scenes.title: Emerald Lake · canoe
scenes.description: Emerald Lake seen through a natural gap in dense spruce forest, deep teal water framed by near trees/ferns, a couple serenely paddling one small red canoe with subtle wake.

scenes.title: Mt Shuksan · red berries
scenes.description: Mt Shuksan behind crimson autumn blueberry/huckleberry slopes in the Mt Baker area.

scenes.title: Telluride · golden slopes
scenes.description: A mountainside near Telluride covered with golden aspens, green conifers, and rugged Colorado ridges.

scenes.title: Frost · first red light
scenes.description: Wednesday's frosted autumn scene preserved at very early dawn, darker blue sky and restrained red sunrise clouds.

scenes.title: Rainier · Sunrise autumn
scenes.description: Autumn at Rainier's Sunrise area with tawny meadows, red huckleberries, dark firs, and Emmons Glacier.

scenes.title: Canadian Rockies · first snow
scenes.description: Golden larches and emerald conifers beneath Canadian Rockies peaks lightly dusted with new snow.

scenes.title: Late autumn light
scenes.description: Golden late-afternoon mountainside, naturally spaced white-barked aspens with yellow leaves, red berry shrub and rust grasses, pale distant rocky ridges, calm ivory air.

scenes.title: Silver Falls · autumn
scenes.description: Oregon's Silver Falls among glowing bigleaf/vine maples, mossy basalt, conifers, and a dark forest pool.

scenes.title: Mt Hood · apple orchard
scenes.description: An apple orchard in the Hood River Valley beneath clearly visible snowy Mt Hood, soft autumn morning light.

scenes.title: Pumpkins · first light
scenes.description: The existing pumpkin patch at darker first dawn, sun barely peeking above the distant ridge.

scenes.title: Red maple lane
scenes.description: Narrow small-town lane lined with mature RED MAPLE trees whose natural red/burgundy leafy crowns arch almost into a tunnel, a few modest distant cottages partly obscured, scattered fallen red leaves and soft light. No apples on maple trees.

scenes.title: Ridgefield · wetland branches
scenes.description: The existing Ridgefield waterfowl wetlands with normal autumn branches overhead and no apples or other fruit.

scenes.title: Plitvice · autumn boardwalk
scenes.description: Autumn at Plitvice Lakes: emerald-turquoise lake and natural tufa cascades, a narrow weathered wooden boardwalk with scattered fallen leaves, beech woodland in gold, rust and orange.

scenes.title: Maple lane mist
scenes.description: Red maple canopy arches over quiet small-town lane in fine pale morning mist, burgundy/crimson foliage and damp fallen leaves, few small distant cottages, understated gray daylight, no fruit.

scenes.title: Oak lake reflections
scenes.description: A calm autumn lake reflecting russet, copper and gold oak trees in smooth water; botanically accurate lobed oak leaves in the foreground, no fruit or apple orchard.

scenes.title: Hoh · Hall of Mosses
scenes.description: An intimate Hoh Rain Forest scene with moss-draped bigleaf maples, towering old-growth spruce and hemlock, sword ferns and nurse logs in damp November mist.

scenes.title: Gorge · tall falls
scenes.description: Slender tall Columbia River Gorge forest waterfall over wet naturally layered basalt cliffs, silver-blue fine water, moss-covered branches and detailed sword ferns at edge, white mist and diffuse late-autumn daylight.

scenes.title: Mt Hood · dawn summit
scenes.description: Sunday's Mt Hood view through mossy forest adapted to very early morning, with just a trace of warm light reaching the snowy summit.

scenes.title: Coastal cliffs through the trees
scenes.description: A view from inside the damp Oregon coastal forest through wind-shaped spruce and mossy trunks to rugged ocean cliffs, slate-teal surf and a misty headland beyond.

scenes.title: Gorge · forest cascade
scenes.description: A different intimate Columbia Gorge stepped waterfall over several moss-covered basalt shelves, fine luminous water strands, cedar branches, realistic sword ferns and subtle white spray, muted slate and moss-green, no spring blossoms.

scenes.title: Rainwood · cedar creek
scenes.description: A wholly new intimate rainy cedar forest scene with a quiet winding creek, mossy nurse log, dense ferns and fine mist.

scenes.title: Mount Hood · morning mist
scenes.description: A second slightly different natural window between mossy forest trunks and curved branches reveals snowy Mount Hood in cool clear morning light, pale low mist, distant snowy summit framed by green damp foreground ferns. Hood clearly one main peak, no full snowy foreground.

scenes.title: Rainier · pink dawn
scenes.description: Snowy Mt Rainier above untouched winter parkland at pink sunrise.

scenes.title: Shuksan · winter cloud
scenes.description: Snowy Mt Shuksan seen across a quiet frozen lake in cool cloudy daylight.

scenes.title: Canadian Rockies · blue night
scenes.description: Canadian Rockies at night beneath a deep dark blue sky, moonlit snow, stars and sparse larch silhouettes.

scenes.title: Clear winter day
scenes.description: Luminous white snowy alpine ridge with pale blue shadow contours, soft clear sky and warm almost-white sun disk partly behind a peak at upper-right, subtle dark cedar sprig.

scenes.title: Lavender winter dusk
scenes.description: Snow-covered peaks under a pale lavender/pink late-afternoon winter sky, blue snow shadows and a small evergreen silhouette at right edge; keep entire left and lower canvas light.

scenes.title: Colorado · winter afternoon
scenes.description: A Colorado San Juan winter valley with rugged mineral peaks, snow-covered aspens and low afternoon sunlight.

scenes.title: Tetons · last light
scenes.description: Snow-covered Teton peaks above a quiet winter river at the last light of the day.
